'''Doffen Gaitag''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Qiraash/Legends|Qiraash]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[84 BBY/Legends|84 BBY]], Gaitag oversaw the construction of a luxury [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Besh Gorgon system/Legends|Besh Gorgon system]]. The station was known as [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]], and was built by [[Bolzi Design & Transmogrification]], an [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] architectural firm. Following the station's completion, it swiftly became one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] premier [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] dens while Gaitag served as its first [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]]. The Qiraash eventually sold the station to the [[J'feh/Legends|J'feh]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Skijid Vrescot]], who hoped to use the station to distribute [[Tirefin]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="VSV1" /> During his life Gaitag fathered at least one child and eventually became a grandfather, with his granddaughter [[Qimberly Gaitag-Delio]] growing up to become a celebrity [[Lawyer/Legends|attorney]].<ref name="VSV2">{{SW|url=news/viva-space-vegas-the-history-of-the-marvelous-wheel-part-2|series=Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Doffen Gaitag was first mentioned in ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', a pair of articles written by [[Rich Handley]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] that were released on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] in [[2013]].
